status_meaning: The DLL is a byte-for-byte capture of the build the owner's gaming PC runs. Its source is in no branch, pull request, tag or commit, so nothing in this repository builds it: build_plugin.py refuses to overwrite it (unless run with --replace-captured-binary), and tools/tests/test_runtime_plugin.py holds the DLL and every pack copy to sha256 below instead of checking sources.

provenance.origin: The owner's gaming PC: plugins/ of its Steam Workshop copy of the SEST Integration Pack (item 3812461539), on Sea Power 0.8.7 Build 261021
provenance.note: sest_runtime.ini and SEST_RUNTIME_README.txt were captured with the DLL. They are not build inputs and may be edited like any pack text; the hashes here record the capture only.

references: netstandard 2.1, Seapower-Scripts, Noesis.NoesisGUI, UnityEngine.CoreModule, AnchorChain 1.1, 0Harmony 2.9 (the DLL's AssemblyRef table); its <X>c__AnonStorey and c__Iterator names are Mono mcs's. The fork base below compiles against Mono 4.5 mscorlib and the AnchorChain stand-in only.
source_note: The .cs files, tests/ and build_plugin.py in this folder are this DLL's fork base, not its source: SEST Runtime Fixes 1.2.0 (its ACPlugin version) as committed since dc46eba2 (24 Oct 2026), which builds 41ff20d9 (fork_base below). An IL comparison of the two DLLs finds 147 of 1.5.0's 317 methods identical to 1.2.0's, 11 changed and 159 new, with 11 of 1.2.0's methods gone: 1.2.0's IMGUI Task Force panel (CostGUI) and its debrief rows were replaced.

fork_base.validation: 178 assertions passed using mocked native APIs; no Unity gameplay claim

dependents.integration/ui-followup/SEST.ContactsFix: pins this sha256 in source/ContactsFix.cs (RuntimeHash), source/CostCatalogueCache.cs and source/DiagnosticModules.cs; beside any other runtime DLL the whole plugin stays inactive

validation: No build and no mocked tests exist for this binary in this repository. The owner's PC ran it with UI Follow-up 1.4.2 on 27 Oct 2026; a crash reported that day is unresolved, its cause unknown.
